altitude.quote: was located on La Palma (Canary Islands) at a height of 2200 m a.s.l.

coordinates.note: The HEGRA collaboration gives 28.750 N, 17.890 W for the experiment, which covered about 200 m x 200 m; the stated precision is about 0.01 degrees (1 km). The point is about 1.4 km from the CTAO-North/MAGIC array point recorded for site:roque-de-los-muchachos-gamma-ray-array.
coordinates.quote: (2200 m a.s.l., 28.750 N, 17.890 W) covering an area of about 200m · 200m

name: HEGRA site, Roque de los Muchachos
notes: MAGIC was later built at the original HEGRA site (arXiv:2406.15037, section 5); the globe keeps the two points separate because the sources give separate positions.

summary.plain: The patch of the Roque de los Muchachos mountaintop on La Palma where the HEGRA cosmic-ray and gamma-ray detectors stood from 1987 until 2002.
summary.technical: HEGRA experiment site at the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma, 2200 m a.s.l., an area of about 200 m x 200 m holding the IACT system, AIROBICC, the scintillator array and muon towers; later reused by MAGIC.
